checks.details: 3 tool actions executed through Context Loader in a managed interaction with every parameter explicit, before and after reinstalling, each matching a local run on the package fixtures; 2 mounted Skills read and checked against source contents; no metrics.

checks.details: 7 reference Cypher queries and 4 graph patterns passed; the other 8 of 15 cards were checked against action results and Cypher queries run with each card's parameters, all matching. No model answered the questions; no model score or browser UI claim.

limits: Native execution covered Linux arm64 with an OpenBKN 0.2.2 main build with bkn-foundry#3125 (bkn-backend 702-act-2d2a597, ontology-query act3125-d089a55a, agent-retrieval sha2d466bc, sample service 022-388d9501); no native amd64 certification and no released vanilla 0.2.2.

Each calculation runs as a tool action through Context Loader (get_action_info, execute_action with every parameter explicit, get_action_execution); every result matched the same generated function code run locally on the package fixtures. Executing these actions needs a platform with bkn-foundry#3125.
Reference queries, graph patterns, actions and every experience card were checked through APIs; no model answered the questions and the browser UI was not exercised.
